remarks: Elevate your business in one of New Canaan's most iconic and visible locations, directly across the street from the Metro North Train Station and only 300 feet from the heart of downtown's celebrated retail corridor. This light-filled second-floor suite offers sweeping panoramic views over downtown New Canaan and the train station below, creating an inspiring and prestigious professional environment. Previously home to a high-end interior design studio and a renowned landscape architecture firm, the space is perfectly suited for creative, professional, or executive office users who value sophistication, convenience, and visibility. Key features: Dramatic floor-to-ceiling windows with unobstructed southern and eastern exposures. Expansive open studio/work areas plus private offices and conference room. High-end finishes throughout, reflecting the architectural excellence of this recently constructed building. Abundant natural light and treetop views of New Canaan's charming downtown. Dedicated entrance and excellent building signage opportunity on Elm Street. On-site parking available + abundant municipal parking in town. Unmatched walkability: 1-minute walk to the train station, steps to boutique shops, restaurants, banks, and Post Office. 215 Elm Street is a new, modern landmark in New Canaan's most distinguished row of office/retail buildings, long recognized for attracting the town's most prestigious tenants.
